name: InfiniBand Trade Association: InfiniBand Architecture Specification and FAQ
notes: IBTA specification landing page and FAQ. States InfiniBand link speeds currently reach 800 Gb/s; copper cabling to 400 Gb/s in-rack, active optical cabling to 100 m, fiber to 10 km; subnet manager provides SDN routing with multiple paths; RoCE was first specified in 2010 and is defined within the InfiniBand Architecture specification.
